The replay script is [gen.py](/app/output/gen.py). The final state is recorded in [meta.json](/app/output/runs/extra_clearance/meta.json), with a [camera image](/app/output/runs/extra_clearance/last/egocentric_mirrored_camera.jpg).

robot.note: move above orange measuring cup, preserve downward orientation and open gripper
lower above orange cup to 10 cm table clearance for visual alignment check
descend to low side-grasp height on orange measuring cup, fingers still open
retreat vertically from blocked low approach to clear the cup and plate
position fingertip tips beside upper cup walls at the last clear height
close Robotiq jaws around the orange measuring cup side walls
small 2 cm verification lift while holding the orange measuring cup
lower closed fingertip tips into the measuring cup opening for an internal grasp attempt
spread fingers gently inside the orange measuring cup to engage its inner walls
raise 1.9 cm with fingers expanded against the cup interior to test internal hold
close fingertips and lower deeper inside the cup before engaging the narrower inner wall
expand gripper at deeper insertion height against the cup inner wall
close onto cup side walls at the lower-body grasp height
small verification lift after closed internal sidewall grasp
withdraw closed fingers vertically clear of cup and plate before changing yaw
yaw the downward gripper by 90 degrees so jaws close across the cup without the blue scoop or handle
smooth joint-space rotation to an alternate downward grasp orientation above the cup
center rotated downward gripper over cup for an x-axis outside grasp
lower along the cup centreline with the jaws rotated away from adjacent utensils
place rotated fingertips alongside the cup outer wall above its base
lower open rotated fingertips to grip lower cup body walls
close perpendicular jaws onto the orange cup lower sidewalls
move closed fingers downward along the taper to the narrower cup body while maintaining side contact
release side contact and retreat vertically before trying the cup handle
hover above the orange cup handle midpoint identified from overhead depth
descend open jaws to grasp the orange cup handle at the measured handle midpoint
close rotated jaws onto the measuring cup handle midpoint
raise the handle-gripped cup by 1 cm to verify the handle grasp
raise the handle grasp another 2.5 cm to verify whether the measuring cup is suspended
continue raising the orange cup by its handle while keeping the grasp closed
raise the gripped measuring cup further until its base is safely clear of the tabletop
raise the orange measuring cup to the required clearance while retaining the handle grasp
increase clearance above the table while holding the orange measuring cup by its handle
raise the securely handle-gripped cup higher to clear the entire bounding box above the table
